001: Excuse me, do you know if this bus goes to the city center?
Yes, this one goes straight to the center. Is it your first time in the city?
It is, I'm a bit lost. How many stops are left?
Don't worry, it's five stops. I'll let you know when we get there.
Thank you so much, you're very kind.
You're welcome, I was also lost when I got here.
002: Hello, one single ticket to the station, please.
That's two euros and fifty cents. Do you want to pay in cash or by card?
By card, please. What time does the next train leave?
The next one leaves at ten thirty. You have plenty of time.
Perfect, so I can grab a coffee before.
Good idea, there's a café right next to the platform.
003: Can you lend me your transit card? I forgot mine.
Sure, but remember it only has rides for today.
Great, one is all I need. Where do I tap it?
At the yellow machine next to the entrance door.
Okay, done. I'll give it back to you when I get off.
No rush, keep it just in case.
004: This subway is really crowded today, isn't it?
Yeah, it's rush hour. How far are you going?
I'm going to the main square. Do I need to transfer?
No, stay on this line and get off at the third stop.
Good thing, I don't feel like switching trains with this many people.
I get you, I also prefer to avoid transferring at this hour.
005: Excuse me, where can I buy a monthly pass?
At the central station ticket office or at the self-service machines.
And what do I need to get one?
Just a photo and your ID. It takes a few minutes.
I recommend going early, because there's usually a line.
006: Does this bus stop at the hospital?
No, this one doesn't go by there. You have to take the number seventeen.
And where can I catch it?
At the stop on the avenue, two blocks from here.
Okay, I'll walk over there. Does it take long to come?
No, it usually comes every ten minutes.
007: I went the wrong direction and now I'm in the outskirts.
Oh no, how did that happen?
I got on the bus without checking the number. What a slip-up.
Don't worry, get off at the next stop and cross to the other side.
And from there can I get back to the center?
Yes, the return bus stops right across the street.
008: Should we take a taxi or the subway to the airport?
The subway is cheaper and takes the same time at this hour.
You're right, but I have two big suitcases.
Ah, then the taxi is better. You don't want to drag the suitcases up and down the stairs.
Yeah, that's true. Should I call a taxi now?
Okay, I'll start bringing the suitcases down in the meantime.
009: Excuse me, is this the stop for the night bus?
Yes, but the night bus only runs on Fridays and Saturdays.
Really? Today is Thursday, what bad luck.
I'm sorry, you'll have to find another way to get back.
Do you know if there's a taxi around here nearby?
There's a taxi stand just around the corner.
010: Good morning, can I get a round-trip ticket to the beach?
Sure, that's four euros and twenty cents. The train leaves every half hour.
And what time is the last train back?
The last one leaves at eleven at night.
Perfect, so I'll be able to see the sunset.
Definitely, it's worth staying until that hour.
